author: James T.
quote: TriCity sealed our driveway last spring and it still looks brand new. Zero staining from our vehicles and it survived a brutal winter without a single crack. Absolutely worth it.

author: Karen M.
quote: The crew was on time, professional, and the stamped concrete on our backyard patio looks incredible now. The colour really popped after sealing. Highly recommend them!

author: Derek L.
quote: We had our walkway and front steps sealed. The whole job took about 3 hours and the results are stunning. Great communication throughout and the pricing was fair.

author: Sandra P.
quote: After years of oil stains on my driveway I finally got it professionally sealed. TriCity cleaned everything up and applied a gorgeous semi-gloss finish. No more embarrassing stains!

author: Mike R.
quote: Excellent service from start to finish. They explained exactly what they were applying and why, and the 5-year warranty gives real peace of mind. Driveway looks like day one.

author: Lisa W.
quote: Our exposed aggregate patio was looking dull and faded. TriCity brought it back to life — the stone colours really came out beautifully. Very happy with the result.
